_schema: Launch control for the quadratic vote at /vote. status: 'preview' (page visible, voting closed) | 'open' (ballots accepted) | 'closed' (results only). Candidates are NO LONGER curated here - they are the live submissions on the board, served by /api/qv-vote (approved KV submissions + the seed builders in data/builder-submissions.json). This file is now just the on/off switch: flip status in a PR to open or close voting.
_note: Season 1 voting is retired. The quadratic ballot ran during month two to gauge what people thought of the projects; it is not how the six finalists are chosen. Zaal picks them. Past tallies are no longer displayed anywhere on the site. Flip status back to 'open' in a PR to run a vote again.
